gloss: Japanese era calendar; Japanese imperial calendar

definitions.gloss: Japanese era calendar; Japanese imperial calendar
definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese way of counting years based on imperial reign names ({元号|げんごう}), e.g., {令和|れいわ} 8 for 2026. Used alongside the Western calendar ({西暦|せいれき}) in official documents and daily life.

examples.japanese: {和暦|われき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write it in the Japanese era calendar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和暦|われき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fill in the document using both the Japanese era calendar and the Western calendar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{和暦|われき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At government offices, the Japanese era calendar is still widely used.

notes:
Years are counted from the start of each emperor's reign and prefixed with the era name (⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧): e.g., ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧⟦{元年|がんねん}→元年：11658_gannen⟧ (Reiwa 1 = 2019), ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧30⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (Heisei 30 = 2018).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和暦|われき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in the Japanese calendar
- {和暦|われき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変換|へんかん}する→変換する：09890_henkansuru⟧: to convert to the Japanese calendar
- {和暦|われき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧: Japanese and Western calendars

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{西暦|せいれき}→西暦：04355_seireki⟧: Western (Gregorian) calendar — the counterpart, used worldwide
- ⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧: era name itself (e.g., ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧, ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧)
